outcome: Drafted the D2 versioned structured-handoff contract (issue #8): a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema (docs/phase-1/d2-handoff.schema.json), one illustrative example that validates against it (docs/phase-1/d2-handoff.example.json), and a compatibility document mapping the envelope to the existing five-field prose handoff (docs/phase-1/d2-handoff.md). Confirmed at base commit f7f45176096c2346957cdf52493017185eda3946 that HANDOFF_FORMAT was text-only and that this draft introduced no runtime parser, prompt change, or adoption claim. Issue #10 later completed the follow-up in this file (see followUp): the runtime mirror, validation tool, and prompt integration now exist.

facts.statement: At base commit f7f45176096c2346957cdf52493017185eda3946, HANDOFF_FORMAT in src/core/policy.ts defined five fields (Outcome, Files, Verification, Risks, Follow-up) and was embedded verbatim into orchestration prompts.

At base commit f7f45176096c2346957cdf52493017185eda3946, the repository had no structured handoff parser or runtime gate; every match for 'handoff' in src/ was a prompt string or a text constant. This historical negative was true of the base, not of the current tree: issue #10 added the strict runtime mirror and validation tool.

D2 of docs/orchestrator-improvements-plan.md proposes a 13-field versioned JSON envelope: version, taskId, status, outcome, facts, assumptions, filesRead, filesChanged, verification, risks, followUp, artifactRefs, reviewState.

At base commit f7f45176096c2346957cdf52493017185eda3946, docs/phase-1 had no tracked files and was absent from the git tree; the schema, example, and mapping document are among the Phase 1 additions to that directory.

Issue #10 implemented this draft's follow-up in the current tree: src/core/contracts.ts mirrors the schema as a strict Zod contract (D2_HANDOFF_SCHEMA, parseD2Handoff, validateD2Semantics, renderD2Handoff), orchestrator_handoff_validate validates envelopes at worker/orchestrator level, and STRUCTURED_HANDOFF_GUIDANCE asks workers for the version-1 envelope alongside the prose. This historical example envelope was never itself emitted by or traversed through a real orchestrated child hook.

assumptions.statement: A structured handoff envelope reduces token cost versus raw transcript passing by 'at least 40%' as claimed by the npm package linked from the plan.
Issue #8 is design-only, so this draft requires no runtime code change to be accepted.

filesRead.scope: Confirmed HANDOFF_FORMAT fields (lines 19-25) and CHILD_TASK_CONTRACT; no edits made.
Confirmed HANDOFF_FORMAT is embedded verbatim; no prompt changes made.
Read plan item D2 (lines 305-356) for the proposed field list and design constraints.
Listed the directory and confirmed via git ls-tree at base commit f7f45176096c2346957cdf52493017185eda3946 that docs/phase-1 had no tracked files (it was absent from the git tree).

verification.command: Example validation against schema (ephemeral Bun script: minimal deterministic validator + Zod cross-check)
verification.result: The example satisfies required fields, enums, const version 1, additionalProperties=false object invariants, minItems evidence, and path/URL patterns; twelve targeted negative mutations each failed as expected.
No whitespace errors reported for the three phase-1 files.

risks.statement: additionalProperties=false on the envelope and every object definition means the draft cannot add fields without a version bump; a future runtime that treats unknown fields as hard validation errors would break forward compatibility with older writers.
The kind-dependent artifactRef path/URL patterns use if/then applicators, which only 2020-12-capable validators enforce; older validator implementations may skip them silently.
The 'at least 40% token reduction' figure from the plan's linked npm package remains an unverified external claim and must not be repeated as a measured result.

followUp: Completed by issue #10 (current tree): the runtime contract module landed at src/core/contracts.ts with parseD2Handoff/validateD2Handoff/validateD2Semantics/renderD2Handoff, the orchestrator_handoff_validate tool (src/opencode-v2/orchestration/validation.ts), and prompt guidance asking workers for the version-1 envelope while keeping the five-field prose rendering (src/core/policy.ts STRUCTURED_HANDOFF_GUIDANCE). This issue #8 envelope itself remains a historical design artifact: it was never emitted or consumed by a real orchestrated child hook.
